title: 29101 - 29101/U0429/050217
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Missing or Invalid Message from Steering Column Control Module (J527 / #16)
Fault Code(s) stored in Steering Column Control Module (J527 / #16)
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Steering Column Control Module (J527 / #16) for Fault Code(s)
technicalNotes: This Fault Code does not contain any Information on what the actual Problem may be, instead it indicates that another Control Module (in this case the Steering Column Control Module) may provide further Details. If no Fault Codes are stored in the Steering Column Control Module this Fault Code can be ignored but you should Kontrol edin: if it comes back - eventually in Combination with Fault Codes in the Steering Column Control Module.
